sections.Profile:
"Fun-Fair" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Genco Manufacturing Co. in March 1958. The game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, four passive bumpers, two slingshots, two kick-out holes, and a gobble hole.

- Manufacturer: Genco Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1958
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Carnival, Original Theme, Shooting, Fair, Guns
